designStatus: Original untested source-fit task protocols, not learner observations

tasks: Use a declared classroom-learning portfolio with a coherent planned task, actual remembered information and a rule/attention change, meaningful group participation, observation/questions/tinkering, and norms made/followed with understanding. Review this broad goal independently rather than sum child-code labels.
Choose a meaningful task goal, say what needs doing and in what order, gather needed materials and begin the plan without repeated adult direction.

Complete the whole time/attention card with a manageable primary mix of tasks: put them in a sensible priority order, identify a real distraction and a useful management strategy, then complete a less enjoyable required task before a preferred one without constant reminders.

These concrete whole-claim requirements fit a primary stage-end situation without importing a secondary homework workload. Old 9–12 guidance remains a separate context; official Foundational 3–8 is a stage window, not an age-three deadline.

Retain ordered immediate recall and hidden-form recognition as different actual memory cases, then change a classroom rule/activity cue and observe an appropriate attention/strategy shift. No single task yields a general working-memory or self-control score.

Use a real turn/wait/choose case: stop to consider two options and likely consequences, select a reasoned action and wait/share when appropriate. A still body or named vocabulary alone is insufficient.

Retain complete instructions/clarification, changed-strategy, whole visual-form, turn-taking and decision tasks separately. Do not infer clinical capacity or manufacture failure/inner confusion from a composite stage requirement.
Actually inspect appropriate familiar objects with simple equipment, use more than one safe available sense where applicable, describe fine details and compare changed cases.

Generate own meaningful questions and identify suitable ways to answer them; manipulate/tinker with suitable objects/materials and test an idea rather than only recite facts. Retain complete existing scientific-question and craft-making checks separately.
No unknown tasting, unsafe materials or required ecosystem-specific factual inventory is introduced. Curiosity is expressed through genuine noticing/questions/exploration, not mandatory enthusiasm.
Participate in establishing/reviewing actual reasonable class norms and explain their purposes, then act accordingly with agency rather than only recite a rule.

Retain whole rule-maker source cases with correctly bound local school/community roles and actual participation; include complete rule reasons and consistent following. Do not import Australian-specific institutional facts or withdraw safety supervision to stage independence.

Use an actual manageable adult-initiated task that was not selected merely from the learner’s interests. Record what the task was and how engagement was shown; it need not become their favourite activity.
Retain full time/attention management checks separately. Following one brief instruction or smiling politely does not establish sustained task participation.

Declare a coherent suitable task and keep the source-specific Grade 1 twenty-minute or Grade 2 thirty-minute engagement period explicit. Movement and different phases within that same task are allowed; unrelated brief activities are not simply added to manufacture the duration.
Record actual duration, prompts, breaks, supports and access at eventual use. A shorter attempt cannot silently prove the selected full-duration condition, and an access need is not a global deficit.
No compulsory silence, motionlessness, enjoyment or fixed universal attention-span norm is imposed. These are suggestive selected-source performance conditions, not new difficulty-level topics.

For the Grade 1 source case actually remember and immediately reproduce supplied information, retaining the selected four-digit same-order example as a distinct source task. Complete four-step instruction/clarification/giving/checking tasks remain separate; action-following alone does not prove exact digit recall.

For the Grade 2 source case actually remember/recall a simple scene and identify missing/significantly changed features across the supplied pair; use a hidden-model recognition check separately for the whole new visual-form claim. The source does not mandate hiding both pictures during its comparison example.
No fixed general capacity score, digit-level clone or transfer from one modality to all memory functions is inferred.

Actually join an ordinary classroom routine, adjust appropriately when a supplied situation/arrangement changes and, in the Grade 2 case, help create a more workable learning situation. Complete a planned shared task and a changed strategy where the first approach does not work.
The actual changed arrangement/routine and learner contribution are recorded. Merely knowing the classroom rules or naming change does not demonstrate adapting.

Use genuine appropriate opportunities for broader error/help/comprehension-monitoring evidence in inherited paths; do not manufacture a mistake, confusion or frustration or infer a child history from this protocol.

Participate in the declared classroom schedule/activity set, including non-preferred activities rather than one convenient preferred example. Actually consider a useful suggestion and show a suitable improvement or reasoned next step.

Retain complete group-work and two-way feedback tasks separately. Feedback use can coexist with disappointment; do not treat a smile, emotional suppression or accepting every suggestion as the criterion.
The explicit revised feedback card and full two-way task are incorporated; source participation/uptake remains directly checked, not inferred from a pleasant mood or an edge-label change.

Actually wait for turns, follow and help frame/review rules, contribute ideas for changing an activity and take a manageable real responsibility/lead role that supports the group. No knowledge of advanced leadership-style theory is required.

For Grade 1 retain actual movement management; for Grade 2 retain appropriate emotion management. Acknowledge real feelings without requiring positive affect, and use actual suitable self-regulation/choice strategies rather than infer control from stillness.

Retain full group, turn/share, rule, decision and applicable calming checks. No upset is staged; independent real-strategy evidence can only be obtained from genuine appropriate opportunities at eventual use.
Actually take initiative in exploring the immediate surroundings and using suitable natural materials; preserve adult guidance in the Grade 1 case and responsible use in the Grade 2 case.

Use safe appropriately sourced materials, avoid harming living things/places, and follow applicable local collection/access rules. Complete observation/questions/tinkering and craft checks separately; a new conservation-state topic is not inferred from choosing safe materials.

Keep eagerness as a low-stakes contextual channel alongside real exploration. No forced enthusiasm, fabricated motive or automatic GrowthMindset link. Specific initiative can coexist with reserve, frustration or variable interest.

Actually create a functional DIY classroom job chart/poster and use it in the routine. The chart must communicate understandable jobs/assignments or timing through appropriate words, icons or a supplied/devised key; arbitrary scribbles are insufficient.

For Grade 2 actually illustrate the chart/poster and follow it responsibly. Retain whole planning, safe making/joining and mark-control tasks separately; generic mark skill alone does not prove the chart’s communicative function.
Use an appropriate understood language/material set; English alphabet mastery is not a hidden gate. No statistical table/counting claim is linked merely because this is a chart.
